aboutPage.heroTitle: Our mission is making companies digitally resilient, seen from the hacker's perspective.
aboutPage.heroBody: We believe a pentest should not be a yearly ritual. Our pentesters and their AI agents keep testing every day, and you watch the results live instead of waiting for a report.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: AssistSec was started by pentesters who grew annoyed with their own trade. A week of testing, a thick report, a signature and see you next year. Meanwhile the code changes every day, and attackers do not wait for the next audit round.
story.p2: So we built it differently. Our agents keep testing the way we would ourselves, only they never sleep. Everything they find passes a senior pentester before it reaches you. Machines bring the speed, people make the call.

argusWhy.title: Why we built ARGUS
argusWhy.body: A report starts ageing the day it is delivered. ARGUS does not. The portal scans again every month, orders findings by risk, retests the moment you ship a fix and keeps track of where you stand for ISO 27001. No more loose PDFs, just one place where everything lives.

manifesto.title: What drives us
manifesto.body: We do not believe in yearly snapshots. Security is a living practice: test continuously, validate every finding with human judgment and stay until it is fixed. That is what drives us.

ceo.quote: Every company says security is a priority. We built AssistSec so it can be a practice: continuous, transparent and human at the moments that matter.

cta.title: Get hacked by us before someone else does.
cta.body: Create an ARGUS account and schedule your first pentest in minutes. Findings appear live and the pentesters are one chat away.
